package backend

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log/slog"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/Rocketable/platform/internal/rocketclaw/config"
	"github.com/Rocketable/platform/internal/rocketclaw/protocol"
	"github.com/Rocketable/platform/internal/rocketcode"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

// TestStateStoreEquivalenceFixture builds, at this tree's schema, a small State Store with
// the shapes the State Store refactor moves, through this tree's own code paths: real
// bridges against a fake provider for turns, and the test helpers for the rest. It leaves
// work unfinished for TestStateStoreEquivalenceDrain. run.sh copies it into the base tree (FIXTURE=1).
func TestStateStoreEquivalenceFixture(t *testing.T) {
	databaseURL, workspace := os.Getenv("ROCKETCLAW_EQUIV_FIXTURE_URL"), os.Getenv("ROCKETCLAW_EQUIV_FIXTURE_WORKSPACE")
	if databaseURL == "" || workspace == "" {
		t.Skip("set ROCKETCLAW_EQUIV_FIXTURE_URL and ROCKETCLAW_EQUIV_FIXTURE_WORKSPACE to build the equivalence fixture")
	}

	ctx := t.Context()
	primary := "---\ndescription: Agent\nmode: primary\nmodel: gpt-6.1-sol\npermission: {}\n---\nPrompt\n"

	for _, agent := range []string{"main", "job", "channel-agent", "reviewer"} {
		writeAgent(t, workspace, agent, primary)
	}

	require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(workspace, ".rocketclaw", "agents", "reviewer"), 0o755))
	writeAgent(t, workspace, "reviewer/alt", "---\nmodel: gpt-6.1-sol\n---\nShadow prompt\n")
	require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(workspace, ".rocketclaw", "skills"), 0o755))

	words := strings.Fields("granite harbor lantern meadow quartz saffron tundra velvet willow zephyr ox ai to be jasmine copper falcon nebula orchid pylon")
	hold, holdStop := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})

	var (
		mu    sync.Mutex
		count int
	)

	requests := make(chan struct{}, 256)
	provider := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
		requests <- struct{}{}

		for word, release := range map[string]chan struct{}{"HOLDME": hold, "HOLDSTOP": holdStop} {
			if strings.Contains(string(body), word) {
				select {
				case <-release:
				case <-r.Context().Done():
					return
				}
			}
		}

		mu.Lock()
		count++
		n := count
		mu.Unlock()

		text, _ := json.Marshal(fmt.Sprintf("Answer %d mentions %s and %s.", n, words[n%len(words)], words[(n*7)%len(words)]))
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, `{"id":"resp_%d","object":"response","created_at":0,"status":"completed","model":"gpt-6.1-sol","output":[{"id":"msg_%d","type":"message","status":"completed","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"output_text","text":%s,"annotations":[]}]}]}`, n, n, text)
	}))
	t.Cleanup(provider.Close)

	// Remote sessions with and without a selected agent and model; ses_b's shell runs in the background.
	remoteAlpha, remoteFast := openCodeTestSession("ses_a", "Remote alpha", "/srv/app", 3000), openCodeTestSession("ses_c", "Remote fast", "/srv/app", 2500)
	remoteAlpha.Agent, remoteAlpha.Model.ProviderID, remoteAlpha.Model.ID = "build", "anthropic", "claude-opus-4-7"
	remoteFast.Agent, remoteFast.Model.ProviderID, remoteFast.Model.ID = "plan", "anthropic", "claude-opus-4-7-fast"
	remote := httptest.NewServer(&fakeOpenCode{sessions: []openCodeSession{remoteAlpha, remoteFast, openCodeTestSession("ses_b", "Remote beta", "/srv/api", 2000)}})
	t.Cleanup(remote.Close)

	cfg := &config.Config{DatabaseURL: databaseURL, Workspace: workspace, OpenAI: config.OpenAIConfig{APIKey: "test", APIBaseURL: provider.URL},
		Slack:    config.SlackConfig{Channels: []config.SlackChannelConfig{{Channel: "#ops", Agents: []string{"channel-agent"}}}},
		OpenCode: map[string]config.OpenCodeConfig{"box": {URL: remote.URL, Password: "pw", Port: 4100}}}
	locked := config.NewLockedConfig(cfg)
	log := slog.New(slog.DiscardHandler)

	s, err := NewSessionServiceIn(ctx, cfg, log)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, s.Stop()) })

	publisher := &outboundPublisherMock{PublishOutboundFunc: func(_ context.Context, message *protocol.OutboundMessage) error {
		message.MarkDelivered(nil)
		return nil
	}}

	var (
		manager  *threadBridgeManager
		registry *backgroundRegistry
	)

	manager = newThreadBridgeManager(locked, s, log, &bridgeFactoryMock{newBridgeFunc: func(bridgeCfg *Config) directBridge {
		bridgeCfg.SessionService, bridgeCfg.RequestRestart = s, &runtimeRestarterMock{restartFunc: testNoopRestart}
		bridge := NewConversation(locked, publisher, bridgeCfg, log)
		bridge.threads, bridge.background = manager, registry

		return bridge
	}})
	manager.cronRoots = newCronRoots(func(*protocol.OutboundMessage) {})
	registry = newBackgroundRegistry(s, manager, log)
	s.jobs = registry
	rt := &Runtime{Sessions: s, threads: manager, Cfg: locked, Log: log, background: registry}
	shutdown := runTestManager(t, manager)

	n := 0
	web := func(id, text string, kind protocol.InboundKind) *protocol.InboundMessage {
		n++
		msg := protocol.NewInboundMessageFromContent(protocol.SourceWeb, kind, &protocol.InboundContent{Text: text}, true)
		msg.ConversationID = id
		msg.Metadata[protocol.InboundPrincipalMetadataKey], msg.Metadata[protocol.InboundPrincipalNameMetadataKey], msg.Metadata[protocol.InboundPrincipalEmailMetadataKey] = "Alice Example", "Alice Example", "alice@example.com"
		msg.Metadata["web_message_id"] = fmt.Sprintf("fixture-%d", n)

		return msg
	}
	chat := func(id, agent string, prompts ...string) {
		require.NoError(t, rt.CreateConversation(ctx, protocol.Conversation{ID: id, Agent: agent, CreatedBy: "alice@example.com"}))

		for _, prompt := range prompts {
			require.NoError(t, rt.RunTurn(ctx, web(id, prompt, protocol.InboundKindSteer)))
		}
	}
	// cronRun runs a cron job as cmd/rocketclaw's cronRunner does.
	cronRun := func(id, destination string) {
		if destination != "" {
			require.NoError(t, rt.CreateConversation(ctx, protocol.Conversation{ID: destination, Agent: "channel-agent", CreatedBy: "cron"}))
		}

		require.NoError(t, rt.CreateConversation(ctx, protocol.Conversation{ID: id, Agent: "job", CreatedBy: "cron"}))

		msg := protocol.NewInboundMessage(protocol.SourceSystem, protocol.InboundKindPrompt, "Cron job prompt about quartz inventory and harbor schedule", false)
		msg.ConversationID, msg.RequireOutputDecision, msg.SyncDestination = id, true, destination
		msg.Cronjob = &protocol.CronjobMessage{RelativePath: "cron/daily.md", Agent: "job", RanAt: "2026-10-19T08:00:00Z"}

		if destination == "" {
			msg.SlackReply = &protocol.SlackReplyTarget{ChannelID: "#ops"}
			require.NoError(t, rt.RunTurn(ctx, msg))

			return
		}

		require.NoError(t, rt.RunTurn(ctx, msg))
		require.NoError(t, rt.SyncConversation(ctx, id, destination))
	}
	awaitRequest := func() {
		select {
		case <-requests:
		case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
			t.Fatal("timed out waiting for a provider request")
		}
	}

	alpha, beta := "web-session:alpha", "web-session:beta"
	chat(alpha, "main", "Plan the granite migration", "Explain lantern routing", "Compare meadow and quartz", "Summarize saffron notes", "List tundra risks",
		"Draft velvet release", "Check willow metrics", "Review zephyr alerts", "Close the copper ticket")
	chat(beta, "main", "Hello beta about falcon", "Nebula follow up", "Orchid wrap up")

	slack := protocol.SlackThreadConversationID("C123", "111.222")
	require.NoError(t, s.UpsertThread(slack, ThreadState{Agent: "main"}))

	for i, text := range []string{"Slack asks about pylon status", "Slack follows up on pylon"} {
		msg := protocol.NewInboundMessage(protocol.SourceSlack, protocol.InboundKindPrompt, text, true)
		msg.ConversationID, msg.SlackReply = slack, &protocol.SlackReplyTarget{ChannelID: "C123", MessageTS: fmt.Sprintf("111.3%02d", i), ThreadTS: "111.222"}
		msg.Metadata = map[string]string{protocol.InboundPrincipalMetadataKey: "Bob Slack"}
		require.NoError(t, rt.RunTurn(ctx, msg))
	}

	// A cron run reports to a new Slack thread (a copy of its history), and is continued in Web.
	runA := "cron:cron/daily.md:20261019T080000.000000000Z:a1"
	cronRun(runA, "")
	chat("web:"+runA, "main")
	require.NoError(t, rt.SyncConversation(ctx, runA, "web:"+runA))
	require.NoError(t, rt.RunTurn(ctx, web("web:"+runA, "Continue the quartz inventory in Web", protocol.InboundKindSteer)))

	// A one-off cron run reports to a Web chat, with a pending schedule effect.
	runB := "one-off-cron:cron/daily.md:20261019T090000.000000000Z:b1"
	cronRun(runB, beta)

	schedule, err := json.Marshal(protocol.ScheduledMessageState{ConversationID: runB, Agent: "job", Message: "check the harbor again", DueAt: time.Now().Add(48 * time.Hour).UTC()})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = s.AppendEntryID(ctx, runB, &rocketcode.SessionEntry{Version: 1, Type: producerScheduleEntryType, Timestamp: time.Now(), OutputTrace: []json.RawMessage{schedule}})
	require.NoError(t, err)

	// A delegation history and an External MCP binding with private and managed histories.
	_, err = s.AppendEntryID(ctx, alpha+"/call-1", testSessionEntry("delegated granite research", "delegated meadow findings"))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	managed := protocol.SlackThreadConversationID("C900", "900.1")
	require.NoError(t, s.RegisterExternalMCPConversation("ext-1", "main", &ExternalMCPSessionState{Agent: "main", PrivateConversationID: "external_mcp:main:ext-1", ManagedConversationID: managed, SlackChannel: "C900", OriginPairs: map[string]string{"customer": "Carol"}}))
	_, err = s.AppendEntryID(ctx, "external_mcp:main:ext-1", testSessionEntry("private mcp falcon prompt", "private mcp nebula answer"))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	// A shadowed chat whose shadow runs each turn.
	chat("web-session:shadowed", "reviewer", "Shadowed orchid question")

	// A stopped turn.
	require.NoError(t, rt.CreateConversation(ctx, protocol.Conversation{ID: "web-session:stopped", Agent: "main", CreatedBy: "alice@example.com"}))

	stopped := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		stopped <- rt.RunTurn(ctx, web("web-session:stopped", "HOLDSTOP then stop this saffron task", protocol.InboundKindSteer))
	}()

	awaitRequest()

	cancel := protocol.NewInboundMessage(protocol.SourceWeb, protocol.InboundKindCancel, "", true)
	cancel.ConversationID = "web-session:stopped"
	require.NoError(t, rt.RunTurn(ctx, cancel))
	close(holdStop)
	t.Logf("stopped turn: %v", <-stopped)

	// An undo staged in a chat.
	chat("web-session:undo", "main", "First undo velvet prompt", "Second undo willow prompt")
	undo, err := s.ObserveEntries(ctx, "web-session:undo")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, _, err = rt.StageRevert(ctx, "web-session:undo", fmt.Sprintf("%d:0", undo[len(undo)-1].ID))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	// Pins, names, tags, reminders, a goal, remote sessions, Background Jobs.
	pinned, name := true, "Alpha planning"
	_, err = s.UpdateConversationDetails(ctx, alpha, &pinned, &name)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = s.toggleSessionTag(ctx, beta, "customer", []string{"customer"})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, s.PutScheduledMessage("reminder-once", &protocol.ScheduledMessageState{ConversationID: alpha, Agent: "main", Message: "Remind me about granite", DueAt: time.Now().Add(24 * time.Hour).UTC()}))
	require.NoError(t, s.PutScheduledMessage("reminder-recurring", &protocol.ScheduledMessageState{ConversationID: beta, Agent: "main", Message: "Weekly falcon check", DueAt: time.Now().Add(72 * time.Hour).UTC(), Recurring: true, Interval: 7 * 24 * time.Hour}))
	require.NoError(t, s.BeginGoal(beta, &GoalState{Objective: "Ship the falcon report", MaxTurns: 5, PrincipalName: "Alice Example", PrincipalEmail: "alice@example.com"}))
	require.NoError(t, s.syncOpenCode(ctx, "box", cfg.OpenCode["box"], &openCodeShells{running: map[string]string{"sh_1": "ses_b"}}))
	// The last sync was an hour ago, as on any copy, so offline reads the same whenever it is captured.
	_, err = s.db.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE opencode_sessions SET synced_at = synced_at - interval '1 hour'`)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	done := testBackgroundJob(alpha, "turn-done/call/a")
	createTestBackgroundJob(t, s, done)
	finishTestBackgroundJob(t, s, done, backgroundCompleted, false)

	runJob := testBackgroundJob(runB, "turn-run/call/b")
	runJob.origin = &protocol.InboundMessage{Source: protocol.SourceSystem, SyncDestination: beta}
	createTestBackgroundJob(t, s, runJob)
	finishTestBackgroundJob(t, s, runJob, backgroundCompleted, true)

	// Queued and stashed work behind a turn still running when the process stops.
	require.NoError(t, rt.CreateConversation(ctx, protocol.Conversation{ID: "web-session:queued", Agent: "main", CreatedBy: "alice@example.com"}))

	running := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		running <- rt.RunTurn(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), web("web-session:queued", "HOLDME long lantern task", protocol.InboundKindSteer))
	}()

	awaitRequest()

	for _, kind := range []protocol.InboundKind{protocol.InboundKindEnqueue, protocol.InboundKindHeld} {
		msg := web("web-session:queued", "Queued "+string(kind)+" pylon follow up", kind)
		require.NoError(t, rt.StashQueueItem(ctx, "web-session:queued", &protocol.ThreadQueueItem{ID: msg.Metadata["web_message_id"], Message: msg.Text, Principal: "Alice Example", Source: protocol.SourceWeb,
			Kind: kind, Content: protocol.InboundContent{Text: msg.Text}, StashAt: time.Now().UTC(), Inbound: msg}))
	}

	require.NoError(t, shutdown())
	t.Logf("queued turn after shutdown: %v", <-running)
	close(hold)

	// Work a stopped process leaves unfinished, for the drain: a running turn of a shadowed chat
	// with its pending shadow manifest, and running script and task Background Jobs.
	seedActiveTurn(t, s, "web-session:shadowed", "turn-unfinished", nil)
	require.NoError(t, s.startShadowManifests(ctx, s.db, "web-session:shadowed", "reviewer", "turn-unfinished", web("web-session:shadowed", "unfinished", protocol.InboundKindSteer)))
	createTestBackgroundJob(t, s, testBackgroundJob(alpha, "turn-live/call/script"))

	task := testBackgroundJob(beta, "turn-live/call/task")
	task.kind, task.subagentKey = backgroundTask, "/call-task"
	createTestBackgroundJob(t, s, task)

	counts, err := queryStrings(ctx, s.db, `WITH counts AS (
    SELECT 'managed_conversations' AS t, count(*) AS n FROM managed_conversations
    UNION ALL SELECT 'session_entries', count(*) FROM session_entries
    UNION ALL SELECT 'active_turns ' || phase || '/' || terminal, count(*) FROM active_turns GROUP BY phase, terminal
    UNION ALL SELECT 'thread_queue ' || kind, count(*) FROM thread_queue GROUP BY kind
    UNION ALL SELECT 'background_jobs ' || status, count(*) FROM background_jobs GROUP BY status
    UNION ALL SELECT 'shadow_turns ' || terminal || '/' || (child_turn_id = '')::text, count(*) FROM shadow_turns GROUP BY 1
    UNION ALL SELECT 'scheduled_messages', count(*) FROM scheduled_messages
    UNION ALL SELECT 'opencode_sessions', count(*) FROM opencode_sessions
)
SELECT t || ' ' || n FROM counts ORDER BY 1`, "fixture counts")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Logf("fixture rows:\n%s", strings.Join(counts, "\n"))
}
